cohort: 116 postnatal mothers who participated in Prenatal Gentle Yoga and gave birth at Bidan Kita Clinic of Klaten during 2017
finding: There was a positive correlation between the frequency of Prenatal Gentle Yoga participation and the success of normal childbirth.
mod_finding: 91.2% of mothers who routinely participated four times a month in Prenatal Gentle Yoga had normal childbirths.
